biggest_catch: The friend must complete both $500+ in direct deposits AND five debit card transactions within 60 days of account opening — the $100 reward card depends entirely on their activity.
catches: Friend must open a new PrimeWay personal checking account and complete requirements within 60 days of account opening.
Friend-side requirements: one or more direct deposits totaling $500 AND five or more debit card transactions (excluding ATM).
Cap: up to $500 per calendar year (i.e., 5 paid referrals).

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: PrimeWay Federal Credit Union's official page (primewayfcu.com/refer-a-friend) runs a Refer a Friend program paying the referrer for qualifying referrals.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: the referrer receives a $100 Mastercard Reward Card for each friend or family member who completes an available referral offer, up to $500 per calendar year (i.e., 5 paid referrals).

c3.evidence: Mechanism: complete the registration form (or call 888-626-3882) to create a referral profile; enter the friend's name and email; the friend opens a new PrimeWay personal checking account and completes the requirements within 60 days.

c4.evidence: Timing: the $100 Mastercard Reward Card is issued after the friend completes all referral requirements.

eligibility: PrimeWay Federal Credit Union members referring friends or family members.
notes: The referred friend also receives a $100 Mastercard Reward Card after opening a new PrimeWay personal checking account and completing requirements.
numeric_basis: Per-referral reward of a $100.00 Mastercard Reward Card.

steps: Complete the registration form (or call 888-626-3882) to create your referral profile.
Enter the name and email address of the friend or family member you refer.
Friend opens a new PrimeWay personal checking account and completes $500+ in direct deposits and 5+ debit card transactions within 60 days.
You receive a $100 Mastercard Reward Card, up to $500 per calendar year.
